source: Published manual CAD annotations from HouseLayout3D, not MultiFloor3D predictions
floor_assignment: Triangle signed normal Z>0.95; at least 5/7 barycentric samples match the same original MP3D house level via non-stair room floor polygons; |height difference| <=0.25m and XY distance outside polygon <=0.35m. Remaining upward surfaces are unassigned; no invented floors.
height_gate: Major height bands of at least 2m² must have centres within 0.30m per generated scene. Three original house levels fail this criterion and are held.
wall: Manual CAD vertical faces sliced at floor+1.2m, stroke 2cm. Stroke is raster tolerance, not inferred physical wall thickness. Separate .8/1.2/1.6m sections saved.
scope: Assigned annotated floor polygons. Exact indoor/exterior scope still requires review; no deletion based solely on texture.
door_policy: Raw structural raster preserved. Optional explicit open-door hypothesis only bridges annotated door positions with two-sided floor support within 0.4m each side and >=70% sampled doorway support. No scanned door-state inference.
stairs: MP3D stair rooms are not assignment sources for room floors. Multi-height levels are held; staircase connectivity is not flattened into navigable floor.
comparison: Old MP3D maps selected by physical floor-height match, not by assuming old f-index equals original house level index. Nearest-neighbour world-coordinate resampling only, no image registration.
limits: Manual CAD is substantially cleaner but is not a ready-made final occupancy dataset
